chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from Abū Wallād al-Ḥannāṭ, who said:

Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام was asked about a slave-girl jointly owned by two men, one of whom emancipated his share in her. When his partner saw that, he rushed upon the slave-girl and had intercourse with her.

He said: “The one who had intercourse with her is to be flogged fifty lashes, and fifty lashes are dropped from him. Half of her is to be considered free, and from her the remaining half is waived. Upon the one who did not emancipate and had intercourse is one-tenth of her value if she was a virgin, and if she was not a virgin then half of one-tenth of her value. And she is to work to pay off the remainder.”

key_terms.أَعْتَقَ: emancipated or freed a share of ownership
key_terms.تُسْتَسْعَى: she is required to labor to pay off the remaining amount
key_terms.جَارِيَةٍ: a female slave jointly owned in this case
key_terms.قِيمَتِهَا: her monetary value for compensation assessment
key_terms.يُجْلَدُ: is to be flogged as a legal punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if one co-owner frees his share of a slave-girl and the other co-owner has intercourse with her?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a jointly owned slave-girl when one partner emancipates his share and the other then has intercourse with her. Imam Abu Abdillah عليه السلام sets out the hadd-related punishment, the financial liability, and the ruling concerning her partial freedom and the remaining amount to be worked off.
